blurb: Dew Point Brewing Co. is Delaware's only family owned and operated microbrewery located in the historic Garrett Snuff Mill. Guests can visit the tasting room to enjoy Belgian-inspired beers and a family atmosphere. The brewery hosts various community events including music festivals, educational talks, and meet-and-greets.
